hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: LimeSurvey for werewolf's limesurvey form: the project's release, as it ships it (its Composer and npm dependencies inside), pinned by sha256. Wolfi does not ship LimeSurvey. The code goes in /usr/share/limesurvey, read-only on the machine; its two writable trees, tmp/ (published assets, the runtime cache) and upload/ (themes, images, participants' files), are links into the php-fpm service's directory on /data, so every path LimeSurvey derives from them lands there. Its web installer, documentation and Apache files stay out. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
